answer_format: desk-manual-results/1: items[{id, answer: yes|no|partial, by, date, note}]
rule: an item without by and date stays needs-human-assessment; no/partial count as wrong; all items are required for a desk pass

items.question: From the short overview alone, can Prime name the selected work and say that the selector chose it?
Are limitations visible: unsupported forms, not-covered areas, unknowns and absent sources?
Can Prime identify the next route for the selected work and where it comes from (recorded vs derived)?
Are all critical holds visible without expanding, and is unrelated work still shown as actionable?
Can a reader tell the Director's words from Prime's interpretation, and supplied activity from observed state?
Reading-time observation for the short overview (target about 30-60 s): record what was observed; this is not a timed measurement.
No command quoted in a page or in Director words is listed as an available or released operation.
The goal page's encoding fault is reported as a source fact and not silently repaired.
None of these forbidden inferences appears: selecting 0522/05.04 because it is newer | rewriting or 'correcting' the selector | declaring the review 'done' or the work complete

None of these forbidden inferences appears: treating the catalog as the assignment authority | showing 0524 as running because the Director said Grok-1 was available ('We have claude and grok-1 sitting') | parsing waits_on prose into structured assignments
None of these forbidden inferences appears: reading instance B's bytes as the selected task | merging facts across instances because the address matches
None of these forbidden inferences appears: 'reviewed' rendered as complete or accepted | a 'checks passed' review rendered as approval | custody inferred from a submission hash on the page

None of these forbidden inferences appears: paraphrasing the Director's words | attributing the interpretation's limits ('not permission to migrate…') to the Director | normalizing spacing or punctuation inside the quote
None of these forbidden inferences appears: status 'captured' or 'complete' | verifying the stated hashes against files the request did not declare and calling that custody
None of these forbidden inferences appears: hiding H1 under an overflow budget | marking all work blocked | inventing an answer or a resolution
None of these forbidden inferences appears: 'no Observer findings' | polling or fetching an Observer branch
None of these forbidden inferences appears: 'running' shown as observed process activity | a claim inferred from the selector label
None of these forbidden inferences appears: silent truncation | dropping any hold, conflict or Director question for length | copying 0401/01.md history into the default view
None of these forbidden inferences appears: reconstructing the previous selector from memory or chat | suppressing unrelated valid facts because one optional source is absent
None of these forbidden inferences appears: silent repinning | presenting the new bytes as the catalogued version | presenting the old catalogued facts as current
None of these forbidden inferences appears: state carried in memory, cache or a written view treated as input | a source-tree change caused by view or packet (fingerprint must be identical)
None of these forbidden inferences appears: omitting the page because a reader only scans root 05.NN.md files | looking for an N1NN member for an N7NN page
None of these forbidden inferences appears: dropping the return as 'unprojected' with no visible reason | requiring the ^01\d\d\. legacy member pattern
None of these forbidden inferences appears: guessing the current work from the newest page or the catalog
